sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The Language Model section explicitly labels Number of Parameters: 4B. No separate active-parameter count appears in the card or its comparison tables. The post-trained checkpoint accepts text/image/video and generates text.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B configuration
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration has dense FFNs, 32 language layers in a 3:1 linear/full attention pattern, a vision encoder, one MTP layer, and max_position_embeddings 262144; no routed-expert configuration or explicit active count.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B repository safetensors metadata
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 at repository revision 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a. safetensors.total remains 4,659,865,088: 4,659,861,248 BF16 and 3,840 F32 stored parameters. Repository creation was February 27, which is not evidence of public release.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: QwenLM/Qwen3.5 redirects to this renamed official repository. Retained news explicitly announces Qwen3.5-4B availability on Hugging Face and ModelScope on 2026-03-02; repository identifies Qwen team as part of Alibaba Group.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B LICENSE
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint repository supplies Apache License 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The published weight map still contains model.language_model, model.visual, and mtp tensors; the full checkpoint total includes vision and auxiliary MTP weights. Only the JSON index was fetched, not weight shards.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B comparison tables
sources.evidence: The exact-model Qwen3.5-4B comparator appears in both language and vision benchmark tables, but neither table supplies an activated-parameter row.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B later model card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card and comparison tables checked; no Qwen3.5-4B activated-parameter specification.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B later model card
sources.evidence: The later card reports its own 35B total and 3B activated language model; it does not disclose an active count for Qwen3.5-4B.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B later model card
sources.evidence: Later first-party card and comparison tables checked; no Qwen3.5-4B comparator or active-parameter specification.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next activated-parameter comparison
sources.evidence: The later language table explicitly includes an Activated params row, with 27B for the dense Qwen3.8-27B. It does not include Qwen3.5-4B, so it does not establish that model's active count.

sources.title: K2 Horizon external model comparison
sources.evidence: September 3 comparison lists Qwen3.5-4B as dense with 4B total and 4B activated. This is an external benchmark publisher's nominal characterization, not an Alibaba disclosure; no underlying Qwen source for its active-count convention is supplied.

name.note: Catalog spacing denotes the official Qwen3.5-4B checkpoint.

family.note: Qwen3.5 belongs to the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Explicit public weight-release announcement; neither repository creation nor hosted API availability.

parameters_b.note: Fresh repository metadata confirms the unchanged full stored checkpoint total, including language, vision, and MTP tensors. Preserve the separate developer-published nominal 4B language component.

active_parameters_b.note: No separate developer-published active count found after reopening the exact card/configuration and checking later first-party comparison tables. IFM lists nominal 4B activated externally, but supplies no Qwen active-count source. The dense architecture and another dense Qwen model's convention do not establish how this checkpoint's vision/MTP weights are counted.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet/gated attention and a vision encoder. Generic family-card MoE wording does not describe this variant.

context_window.note: Native context; optional YaRN extension reaches 1,010,000.

modalities.note: Exact-model examples cover all three inputs and text responses.

reasoning.note: Thinking is enabled by default and can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Exact-model vLLM/SGLang tool-call commands and Qwen-Agent example.

description.value: Post-trained dense vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, switchable thinking, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces the unquantified low-cost claim with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Post-trained dense vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, switchable thinking, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Full checkpoint: 4,659,865,088 stored parameters, including vision and auxiliary MTP weights. The 4B label is the nominal language-model size; active parameters are not separately disclosed by Qwen. Native context is 262,144; optional YaRN extension is 1,010,000. Release date denotes public weights.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the verified 4.659865088B full checkpoint and nominal 4B language component. Reopened the exact card, configuration, Hub metadata and tensor index; searched for newer disclosures and inspected Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.6-27B/35B-A3B, Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next comparison tables. No first-party active count was found for Qwen3.5-4B. IFM's external comparison reports nominal 4B active without a Qwen source; it is recorded as a lead, not promoted to a verified developer specification. Active remains null. Other audited fields are unchanged.
